card: Refactors `CheckBlockHeader`, `ContextualCheckBlockHeader`, and `ContextualCheckBlock` into public functions in `validation.h`, replacing their `ChainstateManager` dependency with `Consensus::Params` and passing the current time explicitly into `ContextualCheckBlockHeader`. This addresses the tight coupling of block validation logic to chainstate management and system clocks, enabling isolated validation calls and direct unit testing. Over 800 lines of the PR consist of new unit tests covering header and block validation edge cases. The work implements initial steps toward the stateless validation library outlined in #35904.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #35904 ('Factoring out a stateless, side-effect free validation library').

Author description: 'Make the existing CheckBlockHeader, ContextualCheckBlockHeader, and ContextualCheckBlock functions part of the public validation interface... ContextualCheck* functions need a ChainstateManager only to access the consensus parameters. Pass Consensus::Params instead... Pass the validation time explicitly to ContextualCheckBlockHeader instead of reading the system clock internally.'
problem: Contextual block and header validation functions were file-local static functions in `validation.cpp` tightly coupled to `ChainstateManager` and internal clock reads. This prevented using or unit-testing these consensus validation routines in isolation without heavy chainstate setup.
scope_notes: Over 90% of the diff (+807 of +855 lines) consists of new Boost unit tests in `src/test/validation_check_block_tests.cpp` and `src/test/validation_check_header_tests.cpp`.
summary: Expose `CheckBlockHeader`, `ContextualCheckBlockHeader`, and `ContextualCheckBlock` in `validation.h`, decoupling them from `ChainstateManager` by passing `Consensus::Params` directly. In `ContextualCheckBlockHeader`, replace the internal system clock call with an explicit timestamp parameter. Extensive unit test suites are added for isolated header and block validity checks.
